newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks slip slightly after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks slip slightly after U.S. data.

text.p: French shares slipped slightly in the afternoon from earlier highs following an unexpected drop in U.S. October industrial production and after a higher start on Wall Street.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 26.92 points or 1.21 percent at 2,245.10 at 1433 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was up 24.5 at 2,245.
The CAC-index earlier hit a year high of 2,248.39.
